descriptions.__lshrdi3: libgcc2 __lshrdi3: shifts an unsigned 64-bit integer right by b bits.
descriptions.__fixdfdi: libgcc2 __fixdfdi: converts a double to a signed 64-bit integer through __fixunsdfdi, negating around it for negative values.
descriptions.__floatdidf: libgcc2 __floatdidf: converts a signed 64-bit integer to double as high word * 2^32 plus the unsigned low word.
descriptions.__terminate: libgcc2 __terminate: calls the current terminate handler.
descriptions.w3d_eh_context_static_802f4e4c: libgcc2 eh_context_static: zeroes the static exception context once, points its handler chain at a static top element and returns it.
descriptions.w3d_eh_context_initialize_802f4e18: libgcc2 eh_context_initialize: switches the get_eh_context hook to eh_context_static and returns its result.
descriptions.__fixunsdfdi: libgcc2 __fixunsdfdi: converts a non-negative double to an unsigned 64-bit integer (high word from a / 2^32, then the corrected low word); negatives give 0.
